{{Quote|This must be his cousin, Tiny.|Teebo|<ref name="The Tragic Flute">{{Ewoks|The Tragic Flute}}</ref>}}
'''Tiny''' was the name given to a large fish on the [[Endor/Legends|forest moon of Endor]] by the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]]. [[Teebo/Legends|Teebo]] claimed that this fish might be the cousin of his [[Teebo's fish friend|other fish friend]]. When the Ewoks were preparing to leave the [[Coral Castle]], Teebo summoned his small fish friend so that he would create them a bubble to get back to the surface. However, his summons brought "Tiny", a much larger fish. Although Teebo was surprised to see this other fish, he surmised that the two must have been related, and he allowed "Tiny" to create them a bubble so that they could return to the surface. After helping the Ewoks, "Tiny" departed as quickly as he had arrived.
